messages.content: Tell me about a time you aligned different stakeholders around a difficult decision.

During a campus product sprint, engineering wanted to optimize for speed while design wanted more usability testing. I proposed a decision matrix, gathered the team, and aligned everyone on a two-phase rollout with metrics. That let us ship on time and still validate usability with real students.
How would you design a URL shortener for a campus hiring platform?
I would begin with requirements, traffic assumptions, and storage design. I would choose a base62 keyspace, cache recent lookups, and partition analytics writes so the redirect path stays fast.
Tell me about a time you influenced a decision without formal authority while pursuing a Product Manager Intern goal.
